name: Raffles The Palm Dubai

address.street: West Cresent Palm - Jumeirah - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: Perched on the iconic Palm Jumeirah crescent, Raffles The Palm Dubai is where legendary colonial elegance meets the audacity of modern Dubai — a sanctuary of understated luxury rising above the Arabian Gulf.
whats_special: Beachfront Palace Vibes: The hotel boasts over 400 meters of private beach — one of the longest private stretches on the Palm — flanked by lush tropical gardens that feel worlds away from the desert city beyond. Raffles Signature Butlers: True to the iconic Raffles legacy dating back to Singapore in 1887, every guest receives a dedicated butler, a hallmark of the brand's storied white-glove hospitality. Overwater Cabanas: Raffles The Palm features rare overwater pool cabanas — an unusual luxury even by Dubai standards — offering guests a floating escape with panoramic Gulf views. Accor HERA Program Perks: As part of Accor's premium HERA collection, guests enjoy elevated loyalty benefits, exclusive member rates, and curated experiences across one of the world's largest hotel networks.
pro_tip: Book a West-facing suite or villa for unobstructed golden-hour sunset views over the Arabian Gulf — the sky turns into a canvas of amber and rose that no rooftop bar in downtown Dubai can rival.
dont_miss: Raffles Spa: Indulge in a hammam ritual at the award-winning spa — treatments are inspired by ancient Arabian wellness traditions and are not to be rushed. Fireplace Restaurant: The hotel's signature dining destination serves a globally inspired menu with theatrical flair; the weekend brunch here is a Dubai institution in the making. Palm Monorail Access: The Palm Jumeirah Monorail station is a short ride away, offering a scenic and effortless link to Atlantis, the Palm and the Dubai mainland — perfect for exploring without a car.
pros: Iconic location on Palm Jumeirah with stunning ocean and city views
Luxurious all-suite accommodations with private terraces
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Island location requires transportation to reach Dubai mainland attractions
